name: Economic Stability
summary: Financial literacy, credit repair, and generational wealth building through homeownership.
description: Economic stability is the foundation of the WEL9 Methodology. Through the Path to Homeownership ladder, families build financial literacy, repair credit, and move toward generational wealth building — not just a paycheck, but an asset.
servedAudiences: Families in Stages 1–4 of the Continuum of Care
